Centaureissi even left some cake and drinks for me before she left.

units.rawText: Surely nothing can go wrong if they're just moving stock and selling it, right? They won't end up fighting over stuff, will they?

spans.text: Riko is lying down nearby. Upon hearing me mutter to myself, she rolls her eyes.

that
worried.

spans.text: I'll head in and check the interior. Clukay, follow me in a bit.

spans.text: Evelyn signals to Clukay, who is on high alert, and the water gun-armed girl quickly charges forward.

units.displayText: Roger that!

units.displayText: The three of them have stern faces as they move quickly while hiding their tracks. The warehouse is lined with all kinds of cargo, the extent of which a glance could not encompass.

units.rawText: ...This is annoying. There's more stuff here than expected.
units.displayText: ...This is annoying. There's more stuff here than expected.

spans.text: ...This is annoying. There's more stuff here than expected.

units.rawText: The three of us might not be enough to shift it all.
units.displayText: The three of us might not be enough to shift it all.

units.rawText: Hehe, in that case... Allow me to help share your burden!
units.displayText: Hehe, in that case... Allow me to help share your burden!

spans.text: Hehe, in that case... Allow me to help share your burden!

units.displayText: A twin-tailed bunnygirl descends from above, blocking the silver-haired Dolls' line of sight.

spans.text: A twin-tailed bunnygirl descends from above, blocking the silver-haired Dolls' line of sight.

units.rawText: Jiangyu?! When did you?
units.displayText: Jiangyu?! When did you?

spans.text: Jiangyu?! When did you?

units.rawText: We at Team Summer Bunny Party might not have a vehicle like you, but we planned our route before heading out and saved plenty of time.
units.displayText: We at Team Summer Bunny Party might not have a vehicle like you, but we planned our route before heading out and saved plenty of time.

spans.text: We at Team Summer Bunny Party might not have a vehicle like you, but we planned our route before heading out and saved plenty of time.

units.rawText: Your speed is no longer a tactical advantage.
units.displayText: Your speed is no longer a tactical advantage.

spans.text: Your speed is no longer a tactical advantage.

units.rawText: In the end, you need manpower to move stuff. There's no way Team Ocean Dancer can compete with us with just the three of you!
units.displayText: In the end, you need manpower to move stuff. There's no way Team Ocean Dancer can compete with us with just the three of you!

units.rawText: Nope.

units.displayText: We have 4 more aides to help us out.

units.displayText: Deetdeetbeepbeep—

units.rawText: You need experience in a real battle, not fancy moves and pointless showmanship. Banxsy, Evelyn!
units.displayText: You need experience in a real battle, not fancy moves and pointless showmanship. Banxsy, Evelyn!

experience
in a real battle, not fancy moves and pointless showmanship. Banxsy, Evelyn!

units.displayText: Then let us settle this!

spans.text: Then let us settle this!

units.displayText: The maid's gaze is as sharp as a razor as she points her gun at Clukay, who fades into a blur as three jets of water sail through the space where she had been a moment ago.

spans.text: The maid's gaze is as sharp as a razor as she points her gun at Clukay, who fades into a blur as three jets of water sail through the space where she had been a moment ago.

units.rawText: Pathetic.
units.displayText: Pathetic.

spans.text: Pathetic.

units.rawText: You have quick reactions. But this...
units.displayText: You have quick reactions. But this...

spans.text: You have quick reactions. But this...

units.displayText: The blonde maid is about to reload, but then she feels someone tugging on her.

spans.text: The blonde maid is about to reload, but then she feels someone tugging on her.

units.displayText: Jiangyu, this is a critical moment in our showdown.

spans.text: Jiangyu, this is a critical moment in our showdown.

units.rawText: Please do not obstruct me by tugging on my clothing. There is no looking back for a warrior.
units.displayText: Please do not obstruct me by tugging on my clothing. There is no looking back for a warrior.

spans.text: Please do not obstruct me by tugging on my clothing. There is no looking back for a warrior.

units.rawText: Huh? But I'm not stopping you or anything.
units.displayText: Huh? But I'm not stopping you or anything.

spans.text: Huh? But I'm not stopping you or anything.

units.rawText: Jiangyu had been by her side just a moment ago, but now she's got a battle of her own to contend with in another part of the battlefield. She blinks innocently at Centaureissi over a box of cargo that serves as cover.
units.displayText: Jiangyu had been by her side just a moment ago, but now she's got a battle of her own to contend with in another part of the battlefield. She blinks innocently at Centaureissi over a box of cargo that serves as cover.

spans.text: Jiangyu had been by her side just a moment ago, but now she's got a battle of her own to contend with in another part of the battlefield. She blinks innocently at Centaureissi over a box of cargo that serves as cover.

spans.text: Wait a minute, if you're not by my side, then what's pulling on my outfit?

units.displayText: Centaureissi glances behind and sees an arrogant green lifeform clinging to her hems. It waves its other pincer at her, as if to say hello.

spans.text: Centaureissi glances behind and sees an arrogant green lifeform clinging to her hems. It waves its other pincer at her, as if to say hello.

units.rawText: To think this place even has crabs. The Oasis' simulation of the marine biome is truly realistic.
units.displayText: To think this place even has crabs. The Oasis' simulation of the marine biome is truly realistic.

spans.text: To think this place even has crabs. The Oasis' simulation of the marine biome is truly realistic.

units.rawText: Well, at least it's doing you the favor of announcing itself. Looks like this is quite the honorable crab.
units.displayText: Well, at least it's doing you the favor of announcing itself. Looks like this is quite the honorable crab.

spans.text: Well, at least it's doing you the favor of announcing itself. Looks like this is quite the honorable crab.

units.rawText: N-Never mind that. Does anyone know how to deal with crabs...
units.displayText: N-Never mind that. Does anyone know how to deal with crabs...

spans.text: N-Never mind that. Does anyone know how to deal with crabs...

units.rawText: Undine and Jiangyu exchange gazes and then shake their heads to indicate their inability to help. Naturally, their opponents are still pressing the attack.
units.displayText: Undine and Jiangyu exchange gazes and then shake their heads to indicate their inability to help. Naturally, their opponents are still pressing the attack.

spans.text: Undine and Jiangyu exchange gazes and then shake their heads to indicate their inability to help. Naturally, their opponents are still pressing the attack.

units.displayText: Has your main attacker been locked down so easily? We won't pass up this chance!

spans.text: Has your main attacker been locked down so easily? We won't pass up this chance!

units.rawText: Several squirts of water fly through the air, forcing them apart. Undine and Jiangyu are occupied with their opponents and Centaureissi is forced to sit down on a nearby table by the crab.
units.displayText: Several squirts of water fly through the air, forcing them apart. Undine and Jiangyu are occupied with their opponents and Centaureissi is forced to sit down on a nearby table by the crab.

spans.text: Several squirts of water fly through the air, forcing them apart. Undine and Jiangyu are occupied with their opponents and Centaureissi is forced to sit down on a nearby table by the crab.

units.rawText: This is like a hunter catching two hares at once. Victory is ours.
units.displayText: This is like a hunter catching two hares at once. Victory is ours.

spans.text: This is like a hunter catching two hares at once. Victory is ours.

units.rawText: Jiangyu! Undine! I'll help...
units.displayText: Jiangyu! Undine! I'll help...

spans.text: Jiangyu! Undine! I'll help...

units.rawText: ...Why is this crab so persistent?!
units.displayText: ...Why is this crab so persistent?!

spans.text: ...Why is this crab so persistent?!

units.displayText: As I arrive fashionably late on my little scooter, I can hear Centaureissi yelling from a long way off. I jump off the bike and run into the warehouse within moments.

units.rawText: What on earth...
units.displayText: What on earth...

spans.text: What on earth...

units.rawText: Taste my water balloons!
units.displayText: Taste my water balloons!

spans.text: Taste my water balloons!

units.rawText: Now that the enemy's main attacker has been neutralized, Evelyn rampages even more wildly, switching her water gun for thrown water balloons. As several of them fly toward Jiangyu, her plan to retreat is stymied by my sudden entrance.
units.displayText: Now that the enemy's main attacker has been neutralized, Evelyn rampages even more wildly, switching her water gun for thrown water balloons. As several of them fly toward Jiangyu, her plan to retreat is stymied by my sudden entrance.

units.rawText: ...Is going... Hng! Jiangyu...
units.displayText: ...Is going... Hng! Jiangyu...

spans.text: ...Is going... Hng! Jiangyu...

units.rawText: Wha? Professor?
units.displayText: Wha? Professor?

spans.text: Wha? Professor?

units.rawText: Sploosh—
units.displayText: Sploosh—

spans.text: Sploosh—

units.rawText: Look out, Professor!
units.displayText: Look out, Professor!

spans.text: Look out, Professor!

units.displayText: Jiangyu and I are drenched by a torrential downpour.

spans.text: Jiangyu and I are drenched by a torrential downpour.

units.rawText: Uuurgh... I got hit... I guess I'm out.
units.displayText: Uuurgh... I got hit... I guess I'm out.

spans.text: Uuurgh... I got hit... I guess I'm out.

units.rawText: Unable to see because of all the water streaming down her face and obscuring her eyes, Jiangyu can only wring out her bunny ears.
units.displayText: Unable to see because of all the water streaming down her face and obscuring her eyes, Jiangyu can only wring out her bunny ears.

spans.text: Unable to see because of all the water streaming down her face and obscuring her eyes, Jiangyu can only wring out her bunny ears.

units.rawText: What are you doing here, Professor?
units.displayText: What are you doing here, Professor?

spans.text: What are you doing here, Professor?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Professor. I didn't expect you to show up all of a sudden.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Professor. I didn't expect you to show up all of a sudden.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Professor. I didn't expect you to show up all of a sudden.

units.rawText: Team Ocean Dancer runs up to apologize. Their leader, Clukay, seems especially nervous.
units.displayText: Team Ocean Dancer runs up to apologize. Their leader, Clukay, seems especially nervous.

spans.text: Team Ocean Dancer runs up to apologize. Their leader, Clukay, seems especially nervous.

units.rawText: She quickly pats my body down over, as though she's terrified she'll find a bullet hole in me or something.
units.displayText: She quickly pats my body down over, as though she's terrified she'll find a bullet hole in me or something.

spans.text: She quickly pats my body down over, as though she's terrified she'll find a bullet hole in me or something.

units.rawText: Hold it, hold it, Clukay, what are you...
units.displayText: Hold it, hold it, Clukay, what are you...

spans.text: Hold it, hold it, Clukay, what are you...

units.rawText: You got hit in the head by three water balloons. Are you sure you're okay?
units.displayText: You got hit in the head by three water balloons. Are you sure you're okay?

spans.text: You got hit in the head by three water balloons. Are you sure you're okay?

units.rawText: Her finger is cool as she swipes my soaked hair aside to examine my forehead. After checking repeatedly, she breathes a sigh of relief.
units.displayText: Her finger is cool as she swipes my soaked hair aside to examine my forehead. After checking repeatedly, she breathes a sigh of relief.

spans.text: Her finger is cool as she swipes my soaked hair aside to examine my forehead. After checking repeatedly, she breathes a sigh of relief.

units.rawText: Right, you don't need bandaging. Don't be so reckless in the future, alright? If this happened on the battlefield... Never mind, pretend I never said anything.
units.displayText: Right, you don't need bandaging. Don't be so reckless in the future, alright? If this happened on the battlefield... Never mind, pretend I never said anything.

spans.text: Right, you don't need bandaging. Don't be so reckless in the future, alright? If this happened on the battlefield... Never mind, pretend I never said anything.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, what are you doing here? I'm pretty sure we stashed you away safely before we left. Were Miss Nora's books so boring you decided to come here to look for some excitement?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, what are you doing here? I'm pretty sure we stashed you away safely before we left. Were Miss Nora's books so boring you decided to come here to look for some excitement?

spans.text: Speaking of which, what are you doing here? I'm pretty sure we stashed you away safely before we left. Were Miss Nora's books so boring you decided to come here to look for some excitement?

units.rawText: Ah, I heard Centaureissi yelling while I was passing by. I came here to look because I was curious.
units.displayText: Ah, I heard Centaureissi yelling while I was passing by. I came here to look because I was curious.

spans.text: Ah, I heard Centaureissi yelling while I was passing by. I came here to look because I was curious.

units.rawText: Don't worry, she's fine. She was just frightened into sitting down on the table by a crab.
units.displayText: Don't worry, she's fine. She was just frightened into sitting down on the table by a crab.

spans.text: Don't worry, she's fine. She was just frightened into sitting down on the table by a crab.

units.rawText: Meh, the way I see it, the Professor went full mother-hen mode and snuck in here because they were worried about us.
units.displayText: Meh, the way I see it, the Professor went full mother-hen mode and snuck in here because they were worried about us.

spans.text: Meh, the way I see it, the Professor went full mother-hen mode and snuck in here because they were worried about us.

units.rawText: Looks like I nailed it.
units.displayText: Looks like I nailed it.

spans.text: Looks like I nailed it.

units.rawText: This battle concerns your future, so naturally we had to be serious about it! If you wish to watch, then hide behind me. I'll protect you.
units.displayText: This battle concerns your future, so naturally we had to be serious about it! If you wish to watch, then hide behind me. I'll protect you.

spans.text: This battle concerns your future, so naturally we had to be serious about it! If you wish to watch, then hide behind me. I'll protect you.

units.displayText: That should be our line!

spans.text: That should be our line!

units.rawText: Oi, Jiangyu! You're dead, you don't get to talk.
units.displayText: Oi, Jiangyu! You're dead, you don't get to talk.

spans.text: Oi, Jiangyu! You're dead, you don't get to talk.

units.rawText: But what about my last words... (Grumbles)
units.displayText: But what about my last words... (Grumbles)

spans.text: But what about my last words... (Grumbles)

units.rawText: Curse you, Clukay, I won't let you have Master so easily!
units.displayText: Curse you, Clukay, I won't let you have Master so easily!

spans.text: Curse you, Clukay, I won't let you have Master so easily!

Seeing this, Clukay seizes the opportunity to pepper Team Bunnygirl with shots. Undine is forced to fight back by herself, but she is no match for Clukay's ferocious firepower.

units.rawText: Scherzando... You and Jiangyu won't have died in vain...

units.rawText: I thought this was just a water fight, but it looks like everyone's really gotten into this. Oh yeah, what did Scherzando say at the end?

units.displayText: She said...

spans.text: Raise my hourly wage for part-timing by 20 Diggcoins.
